# Protiba

> Protiba helps schools create and manage weekly timetables for classes, teachers, subjects, and rooms.

## Product

Protiba is web-based school timetable software. School teams can organize scheduling information, generate a weekly timetable, review teacher and room conflicts, and manage schedules from one place. The public website describes support for primary and secondary schools.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://protiba.app/): Product overview and early access information.
- [Demo](https://protiba.app/demo): Example of how a school timetable is created and reviewed.
- [Resources](https://protiba.app/resources): Guide to using Protiba and planning school schedules.
- [Our story](https://protiba.app/our-story): Background on the product and its development.
- [Contact](https://protiba.app/contact): Contact details and ways to reach the team.
- [Terms](https://protiba.app/terms): Terms for using the service.

## Product topics

School timetable generation, class scheduling, teacher scheduling, room allocation, timetable conflict detection, school administration, and academic scheduling.

For current product capabilities and availability, use the public pages above as the source of truth.
